Do you think that I have come to give peace in the earth? I tell you, no, but rather division.
You will be handed over even by parents, brothers, relatives, and friends. They will cause some of you to be put to…
You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake.

All my familiar friends abhor me. They whom I loved have turned against me.

translations.web: “Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents, and cause them to be put to death.
translations.bsb: Brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child; children will rise against their parents and have them put to death.
translations.kjv: And the brother shall deliver up the brother to death, and the father the child: and the children shall rise up against their parents, and cause them to be put to death.
translations.asv: And brother shall deliver up brother to death, and the father his child: and children shall rise up against parents, and cause them to be put to death.
